business_model.claim: PayPal operates a global two-sided network connecting consumers and merchants, with 439 million active accounts across approximately 200 markets as of December 31, 2025.

business_model.claim: PayPal earns revenue primarily by charging fees for completing payment transactions, typically based on the volume of activity processed on its payments platform.
quotes: We earn revenues primarily by charging fees for completing payment transactions for our customers and other payment-related services, which are typically based on the volume of activity processed on our payments platform.

business_model.claim: Beyond transaction fees, PayPal earns revenue from currency conversion, instant transfers, cryptocurrency purchase and sale, interest and fees from consumer and merchant credit products, interest on assets underlying customer balances, referral fees, subscription fees, and gateway services.
quotes: We also earn revenue by providing other value-added services, which primarily comprise revenue earned through partnerships, interest and fees from our consumer and merchant credit products, interest earned on certain assets underlying customer balances, referral fees, subscription fees, and gateway services.

business_model.claim: Consumer-facing products include PayPal and Venmo digital wallets for online and in-person payments, BNPL (including Paidy in Japan), PayPal- and Venmo-branded credit and debit cards, P2P transfers via PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom, and cryptocurrency buying and selling.
quotes: We provide consumers with digital wallets and other solutions that allow them to shop and pay with PayPal and Venmo—both online and in-person—manage their finances (including saving and buying and selling cryptocurrencies), and send and receive money between friends and family.

business_model.claim: Merchant-facing products include branded and unbranded online checkout, in-person point-of-sale solutions, BNPL, business financing (PPWC and PPBL), payouts, payments orchestration, and fraud prevention and risk management.
quotes: We provide large enterprises and small and medium businesses with online branded checkout solutions, including PayPal and Venmo; online unbranded payments processing; PayPal buy now, pay later ("BNPL") solutions; in-person point of sale solutions; business financing; payouts capabilities; and risk tools.

business_model.claim: In FY2025, net revenues of $33,172 million increased 4% year-over-year, driven primarily by 7% growth in TPV to $1.79 trillion and increased interest and fee revenue on the loans receivable portfolio.
quotes: Net revenues increased $1.4 billion, or 4%, in 2025 compared to 2024 driven primarily by growth in total payment volume ("TPV", as defined below under "Key Metrics") of 7% and an increase in interest and fee revenue earned on our loans receivable portfolio, partially offset by the unfavorable impact of hedging activities.

business_model.claim: In Q3 2026, TPV grew 6% to $487,138 million and payment transactions grew 7% to 6.8 billion, while active accounts grew 0.6% to 440 million, driving 2% net revenue growth to $8,584 million.
